capabilities.title: Support that connects people and technology
capabilities.intro: I bring a calm, practical approach to troubleshooting, documentation, website maintenance, and cross-team communication.
capabilities.supportBody: Assist with hardware, software, configuration, peripherals, access, and day-to-day workflow issues.
capabilities.troubleshootingBody: Reproduce issues, collect evidence, isolate likely causes, escalate clearly, and verify the result.
capabilities.websiteBody: Maintain WordPress and HTML/CSS websites while investigating browser, content, and reported defects.
capabilities.systemsBody: Create troubleshooting guides, user instructions, bug reports, and handover notes.

approach.title: A clear path from issue to resolution
approach.intro: A practical workflow for understanding impact, finding the cause, confirming the fix, and leaving useful documentation behind.
approach.listenBody: Understand the user, expected behavior, environment, and impact.
approach.triageBody: Assess urgency, scope, affected users, and business impact.
approach.reproduceBody: Capture dependable steps, symptoms, versions, and evidence.
approach.diagnoseBody: Isolate the likely cause across software, hardware, data, or workflow.
approach.resolveBody: Apply a safe fix, verify the result, or escalate with clear evidence.
approach.documentBody: Record the resolution and turn it into reusable knowledge.

evidence.title: A closer look at the work.
evidence.intro: Real projects. Practical thinking. Explore the systems behind my experience in troubleshooting, quality, and documentation.
evidence.noorBody: A Rust, GTK4, and libadwaita notes application with a responsive library and editor, rich and source modes, encrypted local storage, autosave and recovery behavior, Linux packaging, accessibility-aware controls, and automated verification.
evidence.noorAlt: Noor Notes editor with a sample launch checklist, note library, and formatting tools
evidence.medicineBody: A Node.js, Express, EJS, and MySQL prototype covering user, shopkeeper, and administrator roles. Features include medicine search, inventory, requests, sales, expenses, exports, backups, validation, and tests. Documented work remains on CSRF protection, rate limiting, security headers, cookies, input validation, and upload security before deployment.
evidence.medicineAlt: Emergency Medicine Finder pharmacy dashboard with sample sales, purchases, and stock summaries
evidence.houseBody: A service-booking system built collaboratively with Node.js, Express, EJS, and MySQL. It includes user, worker, and administrator workflows, registration and authentication, service listings, bookings, verification and hold actions, and file uploads. Individual contribution boundaries are not claimed.
evidence.houseAlt: House Shifting Services catalog with sample studio, family home, and office moving packages
evidence.pciuBody: PCIU CGPA Calculator is collaborative work and is not presented as independently built. No specific individual contribution is claimed.
evidence.noorSummary: A thoughtful Linux workspace for notes, with encrypted storage, rich editing, and recovery built in.
evidence.medicineSummary: Medicine search, inventory, and operations in one application for users, shopkeepers, and administrators.
